source.source_title: Placeholder SDM26 suspension setup for load-transfer screening
source.notes: All values entered 2026-06-10 as typical-FSAE placeholders pending the Suspension sub-team's SDM26 setup sheet. Spring rates 200/250 lb-in, pushrod motion ratios, front-bar-only ARB, roll centers 30/55 mm, unsprung 18/20 kg per axle at wheel-center height, 100 kN/m tire rate.
